decision.question: how to reconstruct a null-parent agent's spawner
options: re-parse every agent transcript for spawn_agent calls naming children
chain registry.parent -> task.jsonl parent_task -> task.cost.agents -> reviewer/clarity name-matches-task-slug -> unknown
decision.why: task-cost.mjs already computed most of this once; re-parsing transcripts is far more I/O for no better coverage

decision.question: how to detect a heartbeat/revive trigger
options: any mention of heartbeat/revive anywhere in the agent's log
only its very first logged line being from servex-heartbeat
decision.why: the broad match tagged ~104 agents including the owner's own top-spend tasks as heartbeat/revive; all 4 spot-checked (task-mastermind-one-dictation, mastermind-page, task-mastermind-inbox-ext, mastermind-ai-3) actually opened with a real brief or a plain resume and only picked up one routine ping mid-session
